nora: quick a11y review request for the left-sidebar search + keyboard shortcut (/) implementation. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/5211. noticed odd SR behavior when using arrow keys in results. can someone sanity-check? :mag: ben: jumping in. what platforms did you see the issue on? yael: repro on mac/VO and win/NVDA. when I open with / the input gets focus but VO announces the searchbox then immediately reads the first result twice when I press ArrowDown. mike: i think we're using role="listbox" with each result role="option" but we also update an aria-live region with count on every keystroke. that double-announcement could come from both the active descendant change and the live region firing. aria-qa: yep - avoid duplicating announcements. prefer keeping active descendant pattern (aria-activedescendant on input) and remove the per-keystroke live dump. instead update a polite region with a debounced summary like "7 results" after input settles. nora: good. also saw that placeholder text uses --muted-300 which fails contrast at 14px in dark theme. placeholder needs special handling. nora?: (oops) yael: propose: keep token but compute mix for placeholder in dark theme, or use a separate token --placeholder-contrast that meets 3:1 minimum for placeholder texts per WCAG. ben: aside: are we exposing the shortcut hint to SR users? Right now tooltip shows "Press / to focus" but it's only visual. should have an sr-only hint that says "Press slash to focus search" on initial focus. mike: implementation details: input should have role="combobox" only if it manages an owned popup; otherwise input with aria-haspopup="listbox" + aria-expanded is ok. combobox semantics are tricky across SRs. I suggest input with aria-controls pointing to listbox id & aria-activedescendant updating. code snippet I used locally:```html
  • Model A
    • ...
``` yael: also ensure results are focusable for keyboard users who prefer tabbing into the list. We can allow Tab to move into the list (set tabindex=0 on the currently active option) and arrow keys to move active descendant. Keep DOM order stable. aria-qa: VoiceOver tip: it prefers native focus on the option for some users. So ensure keyboard behavior has both flows: arrow nav via aria-activedescendant + ability to Tab to focus option elements which then remove aria-activedescendant. avoid hiding options with display:none as SRs sometimes ignore them during keyboard sweep. nora: about announcements: when search yields zero results we currently show a toast. that reads out of context. better to update the polite region with "No results for \"X\"" and move focus back to the input. avoid toasts for zero-result states. nora?: (typo) yael: agree. also for result selection (Enter) ensure the SR reads the action (e.g., "Opened model details for Model A") rather than a file path or URL. keep messages human-friendly. ben: small contrast nit: highlight color for active option uses var(--accent-200) with white text and fails 4.5:1 at 16px. use color-mix to darken accent when option is active or add a dark outline. mike: CSS snippet I prototyped:```css #search-results [role=option].active {background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-200) 70%, black 30%); color: #fff; outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 2px;} ::placeholder {color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted-300) 75%, black 25%);} /* boosts placeholder contrast */ ``` yael: test plan for aria-qa: 1) open via / on mac/VO -> focus lands on input and SR hint announces shortcut; 2) type "mod" -> results list appears; ArrowDown moves active option and VO/NVDA reads it once; 3) Tab moves into list and option receives native focus; 4) Enter opens item and SR reads friendly confirmation; 5) zero-results updates polite region only. test at 100%/200% zoom and with high-contrast theme. aria-qa: will run the checklist today. one note: avoid `aria-live="assertive"` for search; polite is better. also debounce summary to 400ms. nora: action items: mike to remove per-keystroke live updates and wire aria-activedescendant + stable ids, ben to adjust highlight contrast & add sr-only shortcut hint, yael to add Tab-to-focus behavior and unit tests, aria-qa to validate across SRs. I'll add a Storybook 'Sidebar search a11y' interactive case. ben: tiny copy nit: SR label for option should include type context if ambiguous, e.g., "Model — Model A" vs just "Model A" if there are also Docs results. yael: good call. I'll append category in sr-only span. nora: thanks team. assign PR to y/m/b and tag @aria-qa. ping back with any blockers. :white_check_mark:
